title: Tags that can all be true
summary: The output activation when classes are not mutually exclusive.

choices.text: One sigmoid per tag, trained with binary cross-entropy, so any subset of tags can fire.
A softmax over the tags, because softmax is the usual head for more than two classes.
No nonlinearity on the way out, so the raw scores stay probabilities.
A single linear unit, because several labels means regression.
